_recipe.title: Style: whitespace UI film
_recipe.when: Light, quiet product film in the Claude / Apple / Tavus style: warm off-white, tiny type, one floating UI card at a time, the cursor does the work.
beats: Open small: one short line on an empty canvas ("Introducing" then the name). Small type on a big empty frame reads as confidence.
Name card: the product name large, one accent word, nothing else.
Demo: a real prompt typed into a floating card; the cursor clicks; the result appears.
Second demo: a question and the real answer, as a chat.
Three capabilities as big dimming lines (no cards, no icons).
Proof: one real number that counts up.
CTA: a quiet "Try [PRODUCT] →" link, then the logo.
copyTips: Measured on 39 whitespace-UI references: median 5.5 s per shot, and a third of them are one continuous shot. Fewer, longer beats; let the cursor carry the cuts.
Keep type small. The references set body lines at 2-3% of frame height and headlines rarely above 8%. The emptiness is the style.
One accent colour only (warm coral, brand blue or brand orange) and use it on one word per beat.
Never fake UI output: the prompt and result must be copied from the real product.
Night version: --theme studio-dark keeps the same beats.

scenes.say: Describe what you need in plain words, and [PRODUCT] does the rest.
scenes.label: [INPUT LABEL]
scenes.prompt: [A REAL REQUEST A USER WOULD TYPE]

scenes.say: Ask it anything about your work, and get a straight answer.
scenes.label: You → [PRODUCT]
